objective: Prevent intermittent Android route-fatal KL audio errors during chapter/editor navigation while keeping reader, media approval, other audio, and native runtime unchanged.
productionBaselineEvidence: Supabase production bsoc_health_events at 2026-10-31 14:49:31Z recorded RENDER_C567C6DA for KL_CHAPTER_AUDIO on Android 1.3.4, alongside generic global render errors. Root native exception cannot be proven from a hash alone. GitHub main e3f9cd3 inspected. Production OTA run 41211524083 failed on 'main advanced after RC'; no claim that this fix is live.
chosenApproach: Use explicit createAudioPlayer ownership with pause-before-release cleanup, skip allocating native players in empty previews, isolate the KL audio subtree and contain native method failures. React SDK 57 auto-releasing hook cleanup previously called pause after native release.
selectionRationale: Small KL-only surgical correction grounded in Expo SDK 57 audio lifecycle documentation and the KL_CHAPTER_AUDIO telemetry component hint; no shared router, database, or media rendering changes.
alternativeApproaches: Suppress SYS-500 globally (rejected: hides other faults and will not repair invalid audio lifetime).
Replace Expo audio SDK across app (rejected: requires native build and risks calls, speech and media).
Manual KL audio lifecycle and isolated audio failure state (selected: OTA-compatible and minimal cross-feature impact).
preserveBehaviors: Existing signed music/ambience media URLs and user-selected playback remain unchanged.
No new audio begins automatically, and other-app audio takes precedence.
Manuscript, media approvals, reader, Wall, Connect, Quiz, ad policies and database remain unchanged.
No private URLs or user data in logs; no production publication without exact RC and OTA evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Native player pauses before release on unmount and survives erroring pause/release methods
Audio source change cancels prior playback and does not auto-play
Empty media previews do not create audio players
Audio render/native method errors do not replace unrelated screen content
Focused Node tests, TypeScript and Engineering Accountability CI pass
Android device verification then verified RC required before production release
